items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-D (H4 diagnostic, corrected denominator): context-conditioned (reef vs open) committed-class TV-divergence, ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF -- supersedes V3-EXQ-847
items.note: arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-D (H4: measurement aliasing) + the 2026-08-02 active_frac denominator sweep addendum. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-847: chip chip-20260802-v3exq847a-queue, redesign of V3-EXQ-847 per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-847_2026-08-01.md (confirmed, governance-ratified 2026-08-01T22:24:00Z). BUG FIXED: 847's mech448_demotion_lever_live_and_excluding_both_arms / mech449_active_nogo_live_and_suppressing_both_arms readiness preconditions computed active_frac = fresh-only-numerator / n_p2_ticks (ALL P2 ticks incl. held/replayed commitments) -- a basis mismatch that deflated active_frac by the held-tick fraction (40-86% across 847's 6 cells) and produced a FALSE substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route even though MECH-448/449 were actually 100% active on genuine fresh selections (847's own manifest recomputes to exactly 1.0 against n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks). FIX: both demotion_active_frac and nogo_active_frac now divide by n_p2_fresh_select = n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks, matching sibling script V3-EXQ-859's reference-correct pattern. Purely a post-hoc aggregation fix; training loop / RNG seeding / env dynamics / ARMS / hyperparameters unchanged from V3-EXQ-847. SEED SET UNCHANGED [42, 43, 44] (deliberate, investigated this build -- see script docstring PREMISE CORRECTION section): no third documented-good seed exists to substitute for degenerate seed 44 (a standalone env probe this session confirmed the seed-44 degeneracy is a TRAINED-POLICY property, not raw env geometry, so an untested seed cannot be cheaply pre-verified); seeds 42+43 alone satisfy C1g's majority-of-3 floor; extra seeds were not added since MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS/TV_MIN_LIFT_SEEDS are fixed absolute counts, not proportions, so adding seeds without rescaling would silently loosen every C1 subgate's majority semantics. EXPECTED OUTCOME (stated in advance): because the fix is aggregation-only and seeds/config are unchanged, this run is expected to reproduce 847's own already-known DVs (seed 43 bit-identical washout across arms, seed 44 zero reef ticks/self-excludes, seed 42 the only informative cell showing a lift OPPOSITE H4's hypothesis) -- verdict likely FAIL / non_contributory / context_divergence_not_greater_arm_on_measurement_aliasing_ruled_out. The point of this re-run is to let the readiness gate correctly recognize MECH-448/449 as live so the pipeline computes the C1/C2/C3 verdict end-to-end itself, rather than the correction living only as a hand-annotated autopsy note. Smoke (--dry-run, seed 42 only): confirmed the fix -- f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac / go_nogo_active_frac read 1.0 (28 fresh / 28 fresh, excluding 24 of 52 P2 ticks as latched) vs the old deflated ~0.538 that would have failed the 0.8 floor; demotion_non_vacuous / nogo_non_vacuous both True at toy scale. C1/C1g/C2 still read False at dry-run dose, as expected (1 seed of 3, toy episode budget -- same documented dry-run behaviour as V3-EXQ-847 itself). GOV-REUSE-1: the H4 primary DV was already reanalyzed by hand from 847's manifest in the autopsy (no re-run needed for THAT); this run exists so the corrected readiness gate + full C1-C3 pipeline runs natively, per the autopsy's own routing recommendation.

items.title: MECH-122 spindle content-selection validation of V3-EXQ-861 spindle_density DV (MECH-180)
items.note: Validates the MECH-122 content-packaging substrate build (ree-v3 a7d36429fd, IGW-20260801-197) against V3-EXQ-861 confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-861_2026-08-01: spindle_density DV (mean_sws_new_slot_diversity) failed 0/3 seeds under 861s write-count-deconfounded statistic, traced to a missing content-selection channel (MECH-122 content-packaging half, ThetaBuffer.consolidation_summary()/set_consolidation_mode() unwired). Substrate now wires it into run_sws_schema_pass() behind use_mech122_spindle_content_selection (default False, bit-identical off) + mech122_spindle_selection_gain. THIS RUN: identical design/arms/seeds/thresholds/gates to V3-EXQ-861, flag set True uniformly across all 5 arms (orthogonal to mel_on) -- single-variable change. claim_ids=[MECH-180,MECH-122]; evidence_direction_per_claim computed separately (MECH-180 off the full C1a+C1b+C1c/C2 grid, unchanged from 861; MECH-122 off C1b spindle_density seed-pass-fraction alone, since that is the only sub-check this substrate change could plausibly move -- caveat: MECH-122 also depends_on MECH-030/089/121/SD-006, untested here, and its sensory-gating half is untouched). Does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-861 (861s flag-OFF result remains valid evidence for that condition; compares_against_run_id in manifest cites it). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (mean_sws_new_slot_diversity under flag ON) did not exist before this session -- not recoverable, run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): MECH-180 count=3 (677/718/718a) but brake already RELEASED for this lineage (SD-MEL-PRODUCER VALIDATED V3-EXQ-798a) and this run does not reopen the producer question -- tests a NEW substrate condition on the same validated producer, exactly the class a released brake permits; MECH-122 count=0, brake n/a. Smoke test (--dry-run, 3-arm subset) 2026-08-02: flag engages every cycle (sws_spindle_selection_applied=1.00), and mean_sws_new_slot_diversity differs measurably from an identical unmodified V3-EXQ-861 dry-run (ARM_0_NONE_ON 0.0321->0.0324, ARM_3_HIGH_ON 0.0325->0.0327, ARM_4_HIGH_OFF 0.0324->0.0323), confirming the flag is a real, isolated single-variable change at this scale. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings. Readiness/C1/C2 fail at dry-run toy scale as expected (3-arm smoke subset < the 4-arm ON-ladder readiness requires) -- matches 861s own dry-run behavior identically. z_goal_stream WRITER DEFECT inherited unchanged from 718a/845/861 (DEAD_Z_GOAL_STREAM_EXEMPT), not a new defect. Concurrency: TASK_CLAIMS.json contention on ree-v3/experiment_queue.json arbitrated via --allow-overlap this session (owner: determined-ritchie-55a3a6, unrelated EXQ-proposals high-priority batch review) -- genuinely different task on the same shared file (different EXQ entry), not duplicate work.

items.title: INV-087 proxy tethering constraint: untethered (non-potential) maintenance proxy diverts E3 selection from the true-goal optimum; potential-difference proxy (gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s), Ng/Harada/Russell 1999) does not
items.note: EXP-0386, V3-EXQ-674/775 family: controlled E3-selection probe (no env/training) over the REAL e3.select() score_bias path, identical z_world base. 3 arms sharing a matched q_true landscape per probe: CTRL=q_true (no proxy); NON_POTENTIAL=q_true-W_BIAS*(phi_entry+gain_obs) (raw/absolute proximity bonus, retains an irrelevant per-candidate entry-vantage nuisance phi_entry); POTENTIAL=q_true-W_BIAS*gain_obs (potential DIFFERENCE gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s) at GAMMA=1.0, where phi_entry cancels exactly by construction -- the single-hop instantiation of the Ng/Harada/Russell telescoping argument). DV=TRUE(clean q_true)-quality of the E3-selected candidate. PASS=NON_POTENTIAL diverts (loses >=0.5 true-quality vs CTRL) AND POTENTIAL does not (one-sided: loses <=0.25, being BETTER than CTRL is not a violation -- gain_obs correlates with true gain and can legitimately sharpen the softmax landscape) AND the dissociation gap clears 0.25, on >=2/3 seeds. Non-degeneracy: _metrics.check_degeneracy over per-cell true-quality + P0 readiness gate self-routing to substrate_not_ready_requeue if any control is inert (clean landscape discriminative >=1.0 spread; entry-vantage nuisance alone can move the argmin >=30% of probes at the configured PHI_ENTRY_SCALE=24/W_BIAS=4; proxy correlates with true gain >=0.2; uncommitted/multinomial E3 regime active per the 674 finding). PHI_ENTRY_SCALE/W_BIAS calibrated via a pre-registration numpy-only simulation (argmin+softmax, same formulas, before any real run) at the actual N_PROBES=30/N_DRAWS=16/seeds=[42,43,44] scale, giving d_np~0.6-0.7, d_pot~-0.3 to -0.4, gap~1.0 robustly on all 3 seeds -- not tuned against a real outcome. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (E3 score_bias selection dissociation between a potential-difference and a raw proxy) is not recorded in any existing manifest -- this substrate mechanism (proxy tethering) has not been probed before; not recoverable from prior runs. Substrate verified built and ready: E3TrajectorySelector.select() (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:2358, score_bias kwarg at 2370) plus the identical-z_world/score_bias injection method already validated by V3-EXQ-674/775. claim_ids=[INV-087] only (INV-065/INV-086 substrates untouched by this probe). Smoke: --dry-run PASS (1 seed downscaled), validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings across all lint categories, arm_fingerprint present on all 9 cells), P0 readiness diag on the dry-run: clean_landscape_spread=3.25, entry_noise_argmin_shift_rate=0.67, proxy_true_gain_correlation=0.74, probe_uncommitted_rate=1.0 -- all controls active.
